title: Amazon launches Alexa for Shopping as Rufus moves behind the scenes
summary: Amazon launches Alexa for Shopping, integrating its Rufus AI shopping chatbot with Alexa+ across mobile app, website, and Echo Show devices. The assistant can answer product questions, compare items, track prices, set shopping reminders, and handle scheduled or automated purchases.
problem_solved: Simplifies online shopping by providing a unified conversational interface for product research, price tracking, and purchase management across multiple Amazon platforms.
why_valuable: Combines voice AI capabilities with e-commerce functionality to create a more efficient, hands-free shopping experience for consumers.
